nonBlockingObservations.location: Section 1.0 adapter controls and section 1.3 depth stop
nonBlockingObservations.observation: When implementing B2-b0, add a direct 256/257-depth population control that ties the adapter to the walker's existing depth stop. Assert that deeper unseen marker paths do not create units or exclusion rows. This makes the promised native-observation population explicit at the depth boundary as well as pruning and authority boundaries.
